findings.message: U3 (TMP117) at I2C address 0x48: its identity read is not witnessable in the twin: Renode 1.17.0 has no TMP117 model, so no device answers it and its record judges nothing of the part, whose table value is 0x117 under mask 0xffff; only the bench reads it.
